regulation_clause.text: Explicit consent is required to adjust credit (from refund/failed/reversed transactions already paid for) beyond a cut-off of one percent of the credit limit or Rs 5000, whichever is lower; consent sought within 7 days of the credit; on cardholder request, reversal to the bank account within 3 working days.
